response.markdown_report:
Select **bounded-context NextItNet retraining** as the next controlled experiment. At 20% progress, establishing whether older context helps is more informative than adding another gate or mining curriculum.

**Insights from the supplied evidence.** (1) Update-only gates preserve the identity shortcut. They therefore cannot guarantee removal of older information. (2) Electronics has 6.84% sampled training misranking and a 0.4512 tenth-percentile margin. This motivates testing contextual discrimination, without establishing a validation deficit. (3) Replacement interventions have sparse support and frequent matching failures. They cannot establish that stale history causes recommendation errors.

**Insights from related work.** (1) NextItNet’s causal convolutions capture extended context [1]. Restricting their input provides a direct context-length experiment. (2) Highway Networks gate carried and transformed features [2]. Such gates still do not isolate historical positions once representations mix them. (3) Sampled-softmax research shows that candidate competition already emphasizes difficult negatives [3]. Additional mining should follow a uniform-candidate control.

**Framework and directions.** Separate temporal evidence selection, candidate discrimination, and semantic specificity. Their corresponding experiments are bounded histories, uniform candidate cross-entropy, and jointly trained scratch text features; none requires independent prediction components.

Scores below are originality/potential/user alignment/model alignment/difficulty, each 0–10; higher difficulty means harder implementation.

| Idea | Scores | Positive and negative assessment |
|---|---|---|
| Bounded-context retraining [1] | 2/6/7/5/4 | O: clean adaptation / established truncation; P: informs temporal design / may discard useful interests; U: directly excludes distant evidence / compatibility remains unknown; M: tests contextual interference / separation may worsen; D: shared backbone / windowed training costs more. |
| Uniform 32-negative CE [1,3] | 3/6/4/8/4 | O: focused objective control / established loss; P: reusable baseline / sampled gains may not transfer; U: strengthens competition / no recency mechanism; M: targets weak separation / training fit can mislead; D: unchanged inference / careful exclusions required. |
| Scratch title-token fusion | 4/6/6/5/7 | O: family-specific integration / familiar fusion; P: supports specificity / sparse supervision; U: uses item details / cannot infer unmet need; M: enriches representations / may amplify shared-word shortcuts; D: one network / tokenizer and predictor changes. |

**Selected algorithm.** Retrain corrected NextItNet with exactly the latest ten nonpadding items available at every supervised position. Independently encode each causal window with shared parameters and retain its terminal feature. Preserve the inherited loss and optimizer, isolating context restriction.

This explicitly targets **older isolated interests displacing recent matches** and **broad historical associations displacing specific current matches**. It tests whether contextual interference contributes to Electronics’ weak separation; no diagnostic currently proves that mechanism. Compare with the inherited full-context control using pinned macro validation HR@10. Track both displacement failures through the prescribed twenty-user assessment. Preserve one checkpoint per category, all interfaces, seeds, routing and budget limits. No execution or improvement is claimed.

References: [1] NextItNet; [2] Highway Networks; [3] supplied sampled-softmax analysis.

idea.description: Retrain the supplied corrected NextItNet with a strict ten-item causal context at every output position. Encode overlapping windows using the same jointly trained backbone and item embeddings; this remains one network and one selected checkpoint per category. Keep the inherited objective, optimizer and sampling initially so the experiment isolates available historical context.
idea.motivation: The selected experiment explicitly targets two user-facing failures: older isolated interests displacing recent-purpose recommendations, and broadly associated historical interests displacing more specific current matches. Its model-facing hypothesis is that irrelevant context contributes to Electronics’ measured 6.84% sampled training negative-beats-positive rate and 0.4512 lower-decile margin. That connection is unproven: permutation sensitivity establishes order dependence, while sparse replacement support does not establish stale-history harm. At 20% progress, a retrained context restriction provides a useful control before further gating or mining. The supplied inspiration scores are descriptive search results, not evidence that architectural differences caused their ordering.
idea.implementation_notes:
Apply this change within the host-supplied corrected baseline; its source and complete inherited configuration were not included here, so do not invent a replacement scaffold. Fix W=10 before training. Preserve the causal dilated-convolution residual backbone, hidden width, normalization, embedding initialization, scoring head, objective, optimizer and family-specific sample_batch. Do not introduce the previous experimental gates into the corrected cold start.

Implement bounded log2feats(sequence) by constructing, for every nonpadding position t, the suffix ending at t containing at most ten nonpadding items. Left-pad each window to the baseline sequence length if necessary to preserve the inherited positional and padding conventions. Run windows through the same corrected backbone and gather their final nonpadding feature. Scatter these features back into B x L x D, with zeros at padded positions. Each window begins from raw item embeddings; do not slice already-contextualized full-history states, which would retain older dependencies. All windows share parameters, and their scores are never averaged or fused. This construction guarantees input dependence on at most ten items at each position, assuming the inherited backbone has no persistent cross-example state.

Preserve every inherited valid training target and its weighting. Merely truncating each original training sequence to ten positions would discard supervised positions and introduce a second experimental change. Internal windows are computational components of the same logical batch, not additional batches. Bound training memory by processing complete original-example chunks and their associated windows, immediately backpropagating each chunk’s summed valid-position loss divided by the full logical batch’s valid-position count. Accumulate gradients and take one optimizer step per logical batch. Avoid collecting all graph-connected window losses before backward. Verify that normalization does not aggregate across examples or windows; if it does, disclose that chunking changes its behavior rather than silently changing normalization. Preserve inherited clipping and log the additional runtime before committing substantial budget.

Use the same bounded implementation at inference and in ModelView. Preserve item_emb, log2feats(sequence), predict_score(features, items), and the actual view.model nn.Module. The generated working/predict.py must embed the identical window construction, corrected NextItNet architecture and checkpoint configuration. Gather the largest nonpadding positional index for left-padded histories, never count-1, and retain the supplied empty-history convention. Save context_window=10 and the inherited architecture configuration with each checkpoint. Each routed category loads exactly one independently trained model/checkpoint.

Retain DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis), returning measured metrics and explicit metric_definitions. The diagnostic loader remains (None, sequence, positive, negative), with B x L tensors. Preserve the fixed diagnostic negatives and margin definitions. Update structural reachability reporting to include the explicit window restriction: offsets beyond nine cannot affect an output under this implementation, although learned influence within the window remains unknown. Replacement plans outside this bound should be reported as structurally unreachable or used as invariance checks; do not interpret their zero effects as evidence of learned forgetting. Compare interventions only on supported matched positions and report changed support. Preserve the original protocol version in historical records and assign the adapted protocol its own version.

Before long training, check future-token causality, invariance to inputs more than nine valid items before an output, left-padding behavior, all-padding handling, valid-target preservation, and generated-predictor score agreement. Compare chunked and unchunked gradients on a tiny deterministic batch with dropout disabled. These are proposed checks; none has been executed here.

Keep preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, maximum 200 epochs, exactly 200 batches per epoch, single-GPU execution, inherited validation/checkpoint cadence, and the SASREC_EPOCHS default of 200. Retain Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics and CDs_and_Vinyl with unchanged dataset routing. DATA_DIR must remain os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; artifacts remain beneath the trial directory. Count every attempted run and diagnostic against the shared 43,200 GPU-second allowance. Do not inspect other trials or reuse their checkpoints. A full-context control is a separate experiment with separate predictions, never an inference component.

Select only with the host’s arithmetic mean of four category validation HR@10 values under its fixed 200 users/category, 99 unique negatives and seed 42. Do not change splits or evaluator, access hidden test data, or fetch additional data or pretrained weights. Fixed-candidate sampled HR@10 does not establish full-catalog performance. If paired user-hit indicators are available, report category gained/lost hits and descriptive category-stratified paired bootstrap intervals; otherwise state that paired uncertainty is unavailable. Such intervals do not correct repeated validation selection.

Use the prescribed twenty real training users, five per category, for full-catalog unseen-item qualitative follow-up. Track older-interest displacement and broad-association displacement separately, alongside duplicate-function rejection, unsupported compatibility and uncertain identity. Only public histories, timestamps, titles and descriptions are available. Ratings, review text, item categories, prices, stores and simulator traits remain unavailable. Bounded context cannot establish compatibility, replacement need or unmet demand, and it may remove useful persistent preferences. Any behavioral benefit requires observation rather than inference from improved training margins.
idea.pseudocode:
CONTEXT_WINDOW = 10
DATA_DIR = os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']

# Integrate with the supplied corrected NextItNet, retaining its parameters
# and residual-convolution implementation. No independent second network.
def log2feats(sequence):
    output = zeros(B, L, hidden_dim)
    windows, destinations = causal_raw_item_windows(
        sequence, max_nonpadding_items=CONTEXT_WINDOW,
        left_pad_to=inherited_sequence_length)
    features = corrected_backbone(windows)
    last = maximum_nonpadding_position(windows)  # never count-1
    output[destinations] = features[window_indices, last]
    return output

for category in FOUR_SUPPLIED_CATEGORIES:
    set_training_seed(42)
    model = corrected_nextitnet_with_bounded_log2feats(inherited_config)
    for epoch in range(min(configured_epochs, 200)):
        for batch_index in range(200):
            batch = inherited_family_specific_sample_batch(...)
            valid = inherited_valid_target_mask(batch)
            N = valid.sum()
            if N == 0:
                record_skipped_batch()
                continue
            optimizer.zero_grad()
            for example_chunk in fixed_complete_example_chunks(batch):
                features = model.log2feats(example_chunk.sequence)
                losses = inherited_position_losses(model, features, example_chunk)
                (losses[valid_for_chunk].sum() / N).backward()
            inherited_clipping_if_present()
            optimizer.step()
        inherited_validation_and_checkpoint_selection()
    save_one_selected_checkpoint(category, context_window=10,
                                 architecture=inherited_config)

write_predictor_using_identical_shared_architecture_and_window_logic()
# Preserve all four routes, maximum-nonpadding readout and empty-history handling.
# Adapt diagnostic reachability to the ten-item bound; retain measured definitions.
# Host selection uses unchanged four-category macro validation HR@10.
# Do not combine this model's predictions with any control.

originality.positive: Provides an exact context-bound control within corrected NextItNet, addressing the unrestricted historical paths left by update-only gating.
originality.negative: History truncation and shared sliding-window convolution are established techniques; the contribution is a controlled task-specific experiment.

future_potential.positive: Can establish whether context restriction merits subsequent learned temporal selection and separates temporal evidence availability from objective changes.
future_potential.negative: A fixed ten-item horizon may discard useful persistent preferences, and gains would not establish compatibility or unmet-need reasoning.

code_difficulty.positive: Reuses the corrected backbone and scoring head without extra data, pretrained components or independently fitted predictors.
code_difficulty.negative: Preserving all supervised positions requires overlapping-window computation, bounded-memory gradient accumulation, diagnostic adaptation and identical predictor reconstruction.

related_work.title: NextItNet: A Simple Convolutional Generative Network for Next Item Recommendation
contributions: Uses causal dilated convolutions and residual blocks for sequential recommendation.
Provides the required backbone family and motivates controlling the historical context available to its convolutions.
limitations: Extended receptive fields do not establish that every historical interaction is useful.
Does not establish the effectiveness of the proposed ten-item restriction on this benchmark.

related_work.title: Highway Networks
contributions: Introduces gates controlling transformed and carried representations.
Clarifies why gating only residual updates leaves an unrestricted identity path.
limitations: Gating mixed representations does not guarantee selective removal of older evidence.
Does not validate temporal forgetting in NextItNet or this recommendation task.

related_work.title: On the Effectiveness of Sampled Softmax Loss for Item Recommendation
contributions: The supplied search summary identifies informative hard-negative gradients as a property of sampled-softmax training.
Motivates separating uniform candidate competition from additional hard-negative mining.
limitations: Does not establish that mining or candidate cross-entropy resolves the supplied user-facing failures.
Does not justify changing the objective simultaneously with the selected context restriction.
